ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) to 15% high-intensity (white/gray) pixels; high contrast localized at scars and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity black pigmentation covering >90% of both lobes. High-intensity white/gray mottling concentrated at the distal tips (far left and far right). Distinctive vertical high-intensity linear mark on the left medial lobe. Multiple high-contrast circular pixel rings scattered across the mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch; interior angle estimated at 65 degrees with significant depth penetration into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire boundary. Edge profile is modified by external barnacle clusters, creating a jagged, non-linear pixel boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the distal edges, sweeping upward and outward to sharp, high-altitude tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 12 distinct high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both fluke lobes, representing previous barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-intensity linear abrasion on the inner left lobe; multiple faint, unaligned horizontal rake marks visible across the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization along the extreme distal tips and the outer periphery of the trailing edge. Multiple circular scars and a significant vertical scar on the left lobe are present.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive peripheral crusting of barnacles on the tips creates a unique, high-contrast 'beaded' silhouette against the sky/water background.
